title: You Wake Up With a Dog's Nose
topic: You wake up with a dog's sense of smell
mechanism: A dog's nose reads the street like a social feed: every tree is a wall of posts from the neighbourhood's dogs.
format_note: Comedy on the user's script, verbatim (115 words, ellipses replaced by commas). Word count and wpm targets deliberately missed; no factual numbers. Scent is drawn as coloured 3D ribbons; the chicken scent is a giant golden ribbon shaped like a drumstick.

beats.hook: Your eyes snap open, your nose twitches and coffee and pizza scent ribbons fly at the lens.
beats.story: You smell the neighbour's breakfast, yesterday's pizza, then the sock pile: a green sock monster climbs out.
beats.rise: Outside, the street tree is a glowing feed: Max, Bella and Rocky notifications pop around it; Rocky posted 12 times.
beats.twist: A golden chicken scent pulls you down the street, round the corner, to a trash can where a dog is already waiting.
beats.mechanism: The dog stares, thought bubble: BRO. GET IN LINE. A queue of dogs behind it.
beats.ending: You get in line with the dogs, realising dogs were just reading gossip; loop back to the nose macro in bed.

seed.what: Rocky, the dog at the trash can, first seen as the avatar with 12 posts on the tree

characters.look: human puppet, messy bed hair, blue striped pyjamas
stocky brown bulldog-ish mutt, half-lidded deadpan eyes, red collar with a tag
green slimy sock monster with googly eyes and fangs climbing out of a sock pile
human puppet frying eggs in the kitchen across the way
golden retriever avatar with a pink bow

gags.what: The sock monster lunges at the lens; you fall back off the bed
You fling the door open and get smacked by a wall of scent; you stagger
You skid to a stop and slam into the trash can, the lid flips up
